generatedFrom: repository content; regenerate before a release record if any listed input changes

suiteHash.inputs: all versioned files under benchmarks/authoring except hashes.json and ephemeral runs/, ordered by path and hashed as canonical path/content-hash pairs

fixtureDefinitionHash.inputs: all fixtures/** files, ordered by path

sourceSetHash.inputs: all sources/** files, ordered by path

perRunOnly.scorerHash: Hash the exact scorer/runner revision, not this corpus.
perRunOnly.templateHash: Hash the candidate plugin template revision used for the run.
perRunOnly.dependencyHash: Hash the exact candidate lockfile and installed dependency inventory.
perRunOnly.wordpressHash: Hash the WordPress 7.1 install and installed plugin inventory.
perRunOnly.themeHash: Hash the theme slug/version and its active theme.json.
perRunOnly.browserHash: Hash browser name/version plus viewport and deviceScaleFactor.

command: find benchmarks/authoring -type f ! -name hashes.json -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256
